subject: Re: Anthea status: calibration round, template choice matters more than expected
body:
Vera, Bao,

Decision: standard MQM template is the single mandated template for all document-level translation evaluation starting with the Q2 cycle. The paragraph and monolingual templates stay available for research use but their scores never go in a quarterly comparison. Hyun signs off on the methodology note.

Also: no back-filling. We do not re-score historical evaluations against the new template — we mark everything before April 13 as a different measurement regime and move on. Cheaper than pretending we have a continuous series.

Paloma, the deployment is done and it took four days, which is the best schedule surprise I've had this quarter. Readout April 13.

Anders
